exposure: Graptophyllum pictum (aqueous and methanolic extracts at 50 and 275 mg/kg)
cohort: Female Wistar rats with experimentally induced endometriosis.
finding: Graptophyllum pictum extracts demonstrated significant anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and fertilizing effects in Wistar rats with endometriosis, improving pain-like symptoms, reducing endometriosis implant volume and inflammatory markers, and enhancing reproductive outcomes.
followup_time: 25 days (for reproductive outcomes after a 7-day treatment period)
